location.zh: 雪崩后沿雪地找到剑形存档点，接受力量并取得刀斧。击败第一个敌人后拾取押送令，再继续练习防御和精力管理。
location.en: Follow the snowfield to the checkpoint and obtain the dual wield weapon. Defeat the first enemy for the Escort Order, then practise guarding and stamina control.

location.zh: 先搜左支路宝箱，再向前到平台前拾取某个士兵的记录，之后继续主路。
location.en: Search the left branch chest, then collect the soldier's record in front of the platform ahead before continuing.

location.zh: 平台两边都有路，右洞可拾取道具；主线走左边。绕过士兵后到鬼石旁，将第一块鬼石击碎。
location.en: Check the right cave for supplies, then take the left route past the soldiers to break the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 重新经过岔路时不要向下跳。穿过洞窟回到雪地，注意塌陷路面，走左侧上坡取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Stay on the upper route at the junction. Leave the cave, avoid the collapsed path, and take the left slope to the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 顺着火把较多的洞口前进并激活存档点。下层先处理弓兵，雪怪与士兵交战处的右侧小路有有关雪魈的记录。
location.en: Follow the torch lit cave to a checkpoint. Deal with the archer below, then search the right path beside the yeti and soldiers for the yeti record.

location.zh: 推动高处推车打开存档点捷径，途中拾取班吉的识别牌。补给后挑战雪魈王，留意第二阶段增加的冰属性攻击。
location.en: Push the cart to open the checkpoint shortcut and collect Bangi's identification tag. Rest before the Snow Yeti King and watch for ice attacks in phase two.

location.zh: 完成罐子爱好者后回到开场区域，乌鸦附近的罐子现在能找到罐子精灵。
location.en: After finishing the jar enthusiast mission, revisit the opening area and break the jar near the crow for a Jarling.

location.zh: 清理雪原狼群后，绕到木制瞭望塔后方。
location.en: Clear the snowfield wolves and circle behind the wooden lookout.

location.zh: 下坡岔路进入洞窟，清理背身士兵。尸体旁有帝国士兵的日记，左侧是第二块鬼石；离洞后继续经过野猪所在路线。
location.en: Enter the cave at the slope, defeat the soldier, and collect the imperial diary and second Soulstone on the left. Leave toward the boar route.

location.zh: 狼群坡道左侧洞窟深处，士兵尸体与日记旁。
location.en: Deep in the cave left of the wolf slope, beside the soldier’s corpse and diary.

location.zh: 双梯悬崖处先向右绕行洞窟，再从左侧岔路登梯到鬼石平台。
location.en: From the paired ladders, circle right through the cave, then climb from the left branch to the Soulstone ledge.

location.zh: 沿另一条道路通过精英斧兵区域，途中拾取某个班图战士的记录。
location.en: Follow the other path past the axe elite and collect the Bantu warrior's record along the route.

name.zh: 某个班图预言家的记录

location.zh: 过桥后检查右手边，拾取某个班图预言家的记录，再到首领前存档点。
location.en: Check the right side after the bridge for the Bantu prophet's record, then reach the boss checkpoint.

location.zh: 完成罐子爱好者后回访冰封峡谷，查看抵达点旁的罐子。
location.en: After Jar Enthusiast, revisit Ice Canyon and check the pot beside the arrival point.

location.zh: 骷髅倒下后还要打掉残留紫光，防止复活。沿木板前进，打碎左侧岔路木栏，取得神庙第一块鬼石。
location.en: Destroy the purple remains of fallen skeletons. Break the wooden barrier on the left branch for the temple's first Soulstone.

location.zh: 先搜右侧岔路宝箱与对面道具，再回岔路直走。前方士兵尸体上有盗墓贼的手记。
location.en: Search the right branch and opposite pickup, then continue straight at the junction for the grave robber's notes on a soldier's body.

location.zh: 开大门后激活存档点，先检查同层支路。角落罐子后藏着第二块鬼石。
location.en: Open the main door, activate the checkpoint, and search the side rooms on the same floor for the second Soulstone behind the jars.

location.zh: 从大楼梯右侧岔路走到缺口，下去与商人交谈。搜商人旁的记忆，再取得前方发光的冥界气息，增加恢复次数。
location.en: Drop through the opening on the right stair branch to the merchant. Search beside him and collect the glowing Netherworld Energy ahead.

location.zh: 沿下坡进入龙族敌人区域。中央大门尚未开启，先去左侧地面拾取有关龙族的报告。
location.en: Descend into the dragonkin area. While the central door is locked, take the left branch for the dragonkin report.

location.zh: 操作开关进入下层，在存档点附近与达芙罗娜交谈，可使用鬼石强化。左侧楼梯上有侦查队员的破旧日记，随后处理石像机关。
location.en: Activate the switch and descend to Daphrona and the checkpoint. Collect the scout's worn diary by the left stairs before working on the statues.

location.zh: 转动石像让它们相对，升起中央平台。两旁石板会消失，不要踩；从安全平台用标枪打掉对面的第三块鬼石。
location.en: Face the statues toward each other to raise the platform. Avoid the disappearing side tiles and throw a javelin at the third Soulstone opposite.

location.zh: 回神庙需要重新通过石像机关。到圆盘处转左，进入地下通道，左边罐子内有罐子精灵。
location.en: Replay the temple statue mechanisms, turn left at the circular platform, and check the jar on the underground passage's left side.

location.zh: 与达芙罗娜交谈后进入新任务。进洞先检查右侧梯子，爬到顶层取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Enter the new mission after speaking to Daphrona. Climb the ladder on the cave's right side for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 下到村落并激活码头存档点。打开木门后绕到左侧瞭望塔后，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Descend to the village dock checkpoint. Open the wooden gate and check behind the lookout tower on the left for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 仓库区域先探索高层宝箱，再从侧边落到道具平台，拾取右边的避难令后返回主路。
location.en: Search the upper warehouse chest, drop onto the pickup platform, and take the Evacuation Order on the right before rejoining the route.

location.zh: 开门后有雷电龙族强敌，附近滚石也能造成伤害。战后抬头用标枪击碎上方第三块鬼石。
location.en: Defeat the lightning dragonkin beyond the door, using the nearby rolling rock if helpful, then break the third Soulstone overhead.

location.zh: 先检查左侧制作卷轴，再沿主路前进。路旁房屋内能拾取某个雪域学者的记录。
location.en: Check the crafting scroll on the left, then follow the main route to the house containing the snowfield scholar's record.

location.zh: 回访村庄，从房屋前方绕到背面，打破屋后罐子寻找罐子精灵。
location.en: Revisit the village, circle around the house, and break the jar behind it for a Jarling.

location.zh: 进入矿山后检查存档点旁的坡路。沿左侧继续爬到最高处，金色拾取物是冥界气息。
location.en: Search the slope beside the mine checkpoint and climb the left branch to the highest ledge for Netherworld Energy.

location.zh: 经过巨型蝙蝠与沙虫记忆，沿道路走到尽头，用标枪击碎远处第一块鬼石。
location.en: Pass the giant bat and sandworm memory, follow the path to its end, and javelin the first Soulstone in the distance.

location.zh: 经过巨型蝙蝠与沙虫记忆，沿道路走到尽头，用标枪击碎远处第一块鬼石。
location.en: Pass the giant bat and sandworm memory, follow the path to its end, and javelin the first Soulstone in the distance.

requirement.zh: 不使用恢复类消耗品击败巨型蝙蝠。
requirement.en: Defeat the giant bat without using healing consumables.

location.zh: 开门连通开场存档点后穿过木桥，到下一处存档点。沿下坡右侧落下，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Open the shortcut, cross the wooden bridge, and reach the next checkpoint. Drop from the right side of the slope for the second Soulstone.

name.zh: 消化了一半的观察记录

location.zh: 进入毒沼前准备解毒。中间岩石上有消化了一半的观察记录，拾取后尽快回到干地。
location.en: Prepare poison cleansing before the swamp. Pick up the half digested observation record on the central rock and return to dry ground.

location.zh: 处理沙虫记忆后向右侧下落，支路里能拾取铁匠工会许可证。
location.en: Clear the sandworm memory, drop along the right branch, and collect the Blacksmith Guild Permit.

location.zh: 打破木板进入爆炸桶通道，清路后回到毒沼。沿沼泽旁路线靠近发光石头，击碎第三块鬼石。
location.en: Break the boards and clear the explosive barrel passage. Return to the swamp edge and approach the glowing third Soulstone.

location.zh: 沿矿洞路线回到聚集多名丧尸的房间，检查桌边的罐子，取得罐子精灵。
location.en: Return through the mine to the room with several undead and break the jar beside the table for a Jarling.

name.zh: 通缉令：盗贼团账幕之刃

location.zh: 进入城区后打破挡路推车，沿主路拾取通缉令：盗贼团账幕之刃，再向建筑群推进。
location.en: Break the cart blocking the city route, collect the Veil Blade wanted notice, and continue through the buildings.

location.zh: 处理破门伏兵后到下一存档点，走右路进屋爬梯。从上层门出去左转，用标枪打下红色道具，取得鬼气弥漫的圣物。
location.en: Reach the checkpoint after the ambush, take the right room and climb. Turn left outside the upper door and javelin the red pickup for the ghostly relic.

location.zh: 攀到屋顶搜宝箱，再经两段梯子进入建筑。先走右边下层，房梁上是第一块鬼石。
location.en: Search the roof chest and climb the next ladders. Take the right lower route inside the building for the first Soulstone on a beam.

location.zh: 返回楼梯走左路，进入小门继续上爬，顶层可找到第二块鬼石。
location.en: Return to the stairs, take the left route through the small doorway, and climb to the second Soulstone at the top.

location.zh: 打断铁链放下桥，经过存档点沿通路走到桌边，取得沾染手垢的皇帝书信。
location.en: Drop the chained bridge and follow the route beyond the checkpoint to the emperor's worn letter beside a table.

location.zh: 书房拐角墙壁可以打破，暗室内有吟游诗人卷轴，角落罐子中还有罐子精灵。
location.en: Break the wall at the study corner for the bard scroll and the Jarling in the hidden room's corner.

location.zh: 书房拐角墙壁可以打破，暗室内有吟游诗人卷轴，角落罐子中还有罐子精灵。
location.en: Break the wall at the study corner for the bard scroll and the Jarling in the hidden room's corner.

location.zh: 穿过酒窖后检查过道旁两个木桶附近的碎石墙。打开暗室取第三块鬼石，提防里面的伏兵。
location.en: Beyond the cellar, break the loose wall beside two barrels. Take the third Soulstone and watch for the ambush inside.

location.zh: 继续向下层走，沿落脚点逐层下落。必经通道的木板后有第四块鬼石。
location.en: Descend carefully between ledges. Check behind the boards beside the required passage for the fourth Soulstone.

location.zh: 与特利斯坦交谈后进入采石场，放下梯子打开捷径。清理产卵蜘蛛后打掉右侧第一块鬼石，再下行拿食人蛛卷轴。
location.en: Speak to Tristan, enter the quarry, and lower the shortcut ladder. Clear the spawning spider for the first Soulstone and the scroll below.

location.zh: 与特利斯坦交谈后进入采石场，放下梯子打开捷径。清理产卵蜘蛛后打掉右侧第一块鬼石，再下行拿食人蛛卷轴。
location.en: Speak to Tristan, enter the quarry, and lower the shortcut ladder. Clear the spawning spider for the first Soulstone and the scroll below.

location.zh: 穿过蜘蛛窝，先取右侧毒素召唤卷轴。绕过锁住的铁门，沿梯子进下层房间，清敌后取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Cross the spider nest and collect the poison summon scroll. Circle the locked gate and descend to the room with the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 穿过蜘蛛窝，先取右侧毒素召唤卷轴。绕过锁住的铁门，沿梯子进下层房间，清敌后取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Cross the spider nest and collect the poison summon scroll. Circle the locked gate and descend to the room with the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 开门回到主路，从对面道路攀梯，再向下层落脚点前进，取得第三块鬼石。
location.en: Open the gate back to the route, climb the opposite ladder, and descend to the third Soulstone below.

location.zh: 打开连通存档点的大门。搜房时小心爆炸宝箱，对面房间地上有间谍的密信。
location.en: Open the checkpoint shortcut, beware the trapped chest, and collect the spy's secret letter in the opposite room.

location.zh: 绕过马车和强敌继续搜房，破屋内的罐子里有罐子精灵。
location.en: Search beyond the cart and strong enemy. The Jarling is inside the ruined house.

location.zh: 到首领前存档点后先开左侧大门，朝右上方高台投掷标枪，取得第四块鬼石再回去补给。
location.en: At the boss checkpoint, open the left gate and javelin the fourth Soulstone on the upper right platform before resting.

location.zh: 开场剧情后激活存档点，先向来路回头走到底，取得第一块鬼石，再正式进入村庄。
location.en: Activate the opening checkpoint, return along the path behind you for the first Soulstone, then enter the village.

location.zh: 沿左路爬上梯子并跳到屋顶，检查右侧破洞，房梁上的道具是深邃无光卷轴。
location.en: Climb the ladder and jump across the roofs. Inspect the hole on the right for the scroll on the beam.

location.zh: 经隐藏门进入地下，沿管道前进并开铁门捷径。回头打碎木栅栏，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Take the hidden door underground, follow the pipes, and open the gate shortcut. Break the wooden barrier behind you for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 从岔路左边进入蜘蛛区域，先处理头顶蜘蛛。地面的金色拾取物是冥界气息。
location.en: Take the left branch into the spider area and deal with enemies overhead. The golden pickup on the ground is Netherworld Energy.

location.zh: 从红色洞口下去，通过水管梯子到新存档点。搜房时检查左角，罐子精灵就在里面。
location.en: Drop through the red opening and use the pipe ladder to reach the checkpoint. Check the left corner of the room for a Jarling.

location.zh: 沿管道进入图书馆，打开回存档点的门。互动最里面的书柜，密道中有第三块鬼石。
location.en: Follow the pipes into the library and open the shortcut. Activate the farthest bookshelf for the third Soulstone in the passage.

location.zh: 离开书柜密道后向右走，角落拾取坦尼娅的实验记录。
location.en: Leave the bookshelf passage and turn right for Tanya's first experiment record in the corner.

location.zh: 关闭防护罩并乘电梯到实验区，操作书柜密道内机关解除激光。后段电梯运行时跳到中途平台，沿管道取得鬼气弥漫的剑柄。
location.en: Disable the barrier and lasers through the bookshelf passage. Jump from the moving elevator to its intermediate ledge and follow the pipe for the ghostly sword hilt.

location.zh: 回头沿左侧管道走到尽头，取得第四块鬼石后再回机关区域。
location.en: Return along the left pipe to its end for the fourth Soulstone, then rejoin the mechanism route.

location.zh: 操作开关后走精英敌人左侧通道，里面角落有侦查队员的记录。
location.en: Activate the switch and take the path left of the elite for the scout's record in the corner.

location.zh: 走廊左侧隐藏门内可取闪电净化魔法卷轴。回到主路操作开关传送，落点前方有坦尼娅的实验记录（二）。
location.en: Search the hidden door for the lightning cleansing scroll, then use the main switch to teleport to Tanya's second experiment record.

location.zh: 走廊左侧隐藏门内可取闪电净化魔法卷轴。回到主路操作开关传送，落点前方有坦尼娅的实验记录（二）。
location.en: Search the hidden door for the lightning cleansing scroll, then use the main switch to teleport to Tanya's second experiment record.

location.zh: 与特利斯坦交谈后开门进入哨所。搜完房屋另一侧记忆，再绕到楼梯背后打破木牌，取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Speak to Tristan and enter the outpost. Search around the building, then break the boards behind the stairs for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 穿过房间后向左开门，地上有帝国哨兵的记录。回主路下行，左侧铁门内有逃亡者卷轴。
location.en: Open the left gate for the imperial sentry's record. Descend along the main route and search behind the left iron gate for the fugitive scroll.

location.zh: 穿过房间后向左开门，地上有帝国哨兵的记录。回主路下行，左侧铁门内有逃亡者卷轴。
location.en: Open the left gate for the imperial sentry's record. Descend along the main route and search behind the left iron gate for the fugitive scroll.

location.zh: 沿下坡进入左侧监牢，检查牢内拾取物，取得尤利安的项链。
location.en: Take the slope to the cell on the left and collect Yulian's Necklace inside.

location.zh: 到新存档点后继续下行，清理精英，再到左侧平台拾取劳役场行为准测。
location.en: Descend from the checkpoint, defeat the elite, and collect the labor camp rules on the left platform.

location.zh: 搜完附近房间返回左路，接近有士兵驻守的桥时检查右边，第二块鬼石就在桥旁。
location.en: Return to the left route and approach the guarded bridge. The second Soulstone is on its right side.

location.zh: 过桥后沿矿洞推进，吸收途中记忆，检查右手罐子取得罐子精灵。
location.en: Cross the bridge into the mine, collect the memory, and inspect the jar on the right for a Jarling.

location.zh: 清理远程火球敌人后走右路，留意与矿石颜色相近的墙面，第三块鬼石嵌在其中。
location.en: Clear the fireball caster and take the right route. Look closely at the mineral wall for the camouflaged third Soulstone.

location.zh: 穿过城区并激活存档点，沿主路从高处下落后回头，高台上有第一块鬼石。
location.en: Follow the city route past the checkpoint, drop to the lower platform, and look back for the first Soulstone above.

location.zh: 搜完石像附近道具后，打破小门右侧木板，取得主教卷轴，再放下梯子打开捷径。
location.en: Break the boards right of the small doorway for the bishop scroll, then lower the ladder shortcut.

location.zh: 沿楼梯探索水城，回到楼梯口后进左门，门右侧拾取被水浸湿的日记。
location.en: Explore the stairs, return to the landing, and enter the left doorway for the water soaked diary beside the door.

location.zh: 打开小铁门激活新存档点，沿树旁小路进入房屋，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Open the gate to the checkpoint and search the house beside the tree for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 房屋背面可取水净化魔法卷轴，之后沿下方小路到左侧铁门后，取得第三块鬼石。
location.en: Collect the water cleansing scroll behind the house, then follow the lower path to the third Soulstone behind the left gate.

location.zh: 房屋背面可取水净化魔法卷轴，之后沿下方小路到左侧铁门后，取得第三块鬼石。
location.en: Collect the water cleansing scroll behind the house, then follow the lower path to the third Soulstone behind the left gate.

location.zh: 从存档点下行，清精英开铁门，再沿下层右侧窄路前进。贴边走到高处，取得鬼气弥漫的兽牙护链。
location.en: Descend from the checkpoint, clear the elite and gate, then follow the narrow lower right ledge upward for the ghostly fang necklace.

name.zh: 阿尔戴比勒的圆盘碎片

location.zh: 沿下层道路向右绕行回上层存档点，右上方拾取阿尔戴比勒的圆盘碎片。
location.en: Circle through the lower route to the upper checkpoint and collect the Aldevir disc fragment on its upper right side.

location.zh: 从大厅右侧楼梯进入书房，清理骷髅并上楼，鬼石在敌人左侧。
location.en: Take the hall’s right stairs through the study, clear the skeletons, and climb to the Soulstone on the left.

location.zh: 大厅两侧要分别探索：右梯书房清完骷髅后取第四块鬼石；左梯图书馆书架后有罐子精灵，互动书柜还可进入密道取得第五块鬼石。
location.en: Search both sides of the hall. The right study holds Soulstone four; the left library has a Jarling behind a shelf and Soulstone five behind a bookshelf mechanism.

location.zh: 从大厅左侧楼梯进入图书馆，互动带机关的书柜，密道内有另一块鬼石。
location.en: Enter the library from the left stairs and activate the bookshelf mechanism for another Soulstone in the passage.

location.zh: 到存档点后破左侧木板下行，拾取未寄出的信。再乘三层电梯，于中间层跳出，右侧房间宝箱里有鬼气弥漫的宝石。
location.en: Break the boards left of the checkpoint for the unsent letter, then exit the elevator at its middle floor for the ghostly gem in the right room's chest.

location.zh: 到存档点后破左侧木板下行，拾取未寄出的信。再乘三层电梯，于中间层跳出，右侧房间宝箱里有鬼气弥漫的宝石。
location.en: Break the boards left of the checkpoint for the unsent letter, then exit the elevator at its middle floor for the ghostly gem in the right room's chest.

location.zh: 进入山脉与尤利安交谈，沿主路楼梯上行，拾取染血的委托书后继续向石桥前进。
location.en: Speak to Yulian, climb the main stairs for the bloodstained request, and continue toward the bridge.

location.zh: 过桥进传送门后到十字路口，先走右侧。清理骷髅可取猩红恶鬼卷轴，再上右梯向右上高处找第一块鬼石。
location.en: After the portal, take the right branch. Clear the skeletons for the scarlet fiend scroll, then find the first Soulstone high above the right stairs.

location.zh: 过桥进传送门后到十字路口，先走右侧。清理骷髅可取猩红恶鬼卷轴，再上右梯向右上高处找第一块鬼石。
location.en: After the portal, take the right branch. Clear the skeletons for the scarlet fiend scroll, then find the first Soulstone high above the right stairs.

location.zh: 主路上的蝙蝠会积累瘟疫，先清它们再探索楼下吟游诗人房间，身后罐子里有罐子精灵。
location.en: Clear the Plague bats, then descend to the bard's room and inspect the jar behind him for a Jarling.

location.zh: 到存档点后进入传送门，木板区多处会塌。过桥后朝左边看，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Use the portal beyond the checkpoint and avoid the collapsing boards. Look left after the bridge for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 击败小首领后传送回岔路，走左侧上坡。取悬崖边幻觉净化魔法卷轴，再走右岔路到致幻蝙蝠背后取第三块鬼石。
location.en: Return from the minor boss, take the left slope for the illusion cleansing scroll, then the right fork for the third Soulstone behind the bat.

location.zh: 击败小首领后传送回岔路，走左侧上坡。取悬崖边幻觉净化魔法卷轴，再走右岔路到致幻蝙蝠背后取第三块鬼石。
location.en: Return from the minor boss, take the left slope for the illusion cleansing scroll, then the right fork for the third Soulstone behind the bat.

location.zh: 经幻影森林击败小首领并传送返回，改走十字路口正前方。穿过石门后右侧有第四块鬼石。
location.en: Finish the phantom forest encounter, return to the junction, and take the straight route through the stone gate for the fourth Soulstone on the right.

location.zh: 搜蜘蛛卵后的爆炸宝箱，继续探索支路取得鬼气弥漫的锤子，再回主路。
location.en: Search the trapped chest behind the spider eggs and collect the ghostly hammer on the side route before returning.

location.zh: 从要塞破损房间向外走到存档点，互动书柜打开密道，里面拾取随从兰提莫斯的日记。
location.en: Reach the fortress checkpoint and activate the bookshelf passage for attendant Lantimos's diary.

location.zh: 继续通过牢房与楼梯，注意脚下陷阱机关，探索鬼气弥漫的盾牌后返回通路。
location.en: Cross the cells and stairs, watch for floor traps, and search the branch for the ghostly shield before continuing.

location.zh: 清理过道骷髅后打破左侧隐藏墙壁，进入暗室取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Defeat the corridor skeleton and break the hidden wall on the left for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 穿过盾兵与机关通道到塔楼，观察中央洞口的落脚点，跳到下方木板取罐子精灵。
location.en: Pass the shield soldier and traps, then drop onto the wooden ledge in the tower shaft for the Jarling.

location.zh: 返回楼梯上行后从中央洞口下去，检查左侧木箱后，取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Climb back up and descend through the central opening. The second Soulstone is behind crates on the left.

location.zh: 沿外侧道路走左路，再上楼到阳台，第三块鬼石就在阳台区域。
location.en: Follow the left outside route and climb to the balcony for the third Soulstone.

location.zh: 回到分岔继续搜索房间，拾取预言（一）后返回主路。
location.en: Return to the junction, search the side room for Prophecy I, and rejoin the main route.

location.zh: 经过首个门口先上右梯取角落大将军卷轴，再从另一路左梯上行，士兵身后有第四块鬼石。
location.en: Take the right stairs for the general scroll, then the left stair route beyond the doorway for the fourth Soulstone behind the soldiers.

location.zh: 经过首个门口先上右梯取角落大将军卷轴，再从另一路左梯上行，士兵身后有第四块鬼石。
location.en: Take the right stairs for the general scroll, then the left stair route beyond the doorway for the fourth Soulstone behind the soldiers.

location.zh: 先破坏射箭机器。血池边角落有破旧的日记本；到存档点后进大厅，左边拾取瓦尔萨勒的圆盘碎片。
location.en: Destroy the arrow machine, collect the worn diary beside the blood pool, then take the Vaisar disc fragment on the left of the next hall.

location.zh: 先破坏射箭机器。血池边角落有破旧的日记本；到存档点后进大厅，左边拾取瓦尔萨勒的圆盘碎片。
location.en: Destroy the arrow machine, collect the worn diary beside the blood pool, then take the Vaisar disc fragment on the left of the next hall.

location.zh: 进入首领前区域先检查右侧隐藏墙壁，暗室里有第五块鬼石，搜完再开主路大门。
location.en: Before the boss gate, break the hidden wall on the right for the fifth Soulstone, then open the main door.

location.zh: 进剧院上楼先见到暂时够不到的鬼石，改走左门。房间中央地板会塌，先沿边取鎏金卷轴，再下去打第一块鬼石。
location.en: Take the left door upstairs. Collect the gilded scroll from the room's edge before dropping through the collapsing floor for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 进剧院上楼先见到暂时够不到的鬼石，改走左门。房间中央地板会塌，先沿边取鎏金卷轴，再下去打第一块鬼石。
location.en: Take the left door upstairs. Collect the gilded scroll from the room's edge before dropping through the collapsing floor for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 用画作回上层，打破隐藏门进入另一幅传送画，找到吟游诗人与钢琴，琴后有第二块鬼石。
location.en: Use the painting to return upstairs, enter the hidden painting passage, and find the second Soulstone behind the bard's piano.

location.zh: 出铁门清理唱歌敌人，沿旋转楼梯上行，钢琴前拾取皇室音乐教师的手记。
location.en: Clear the singing enemy beyond the gate, climb the spiral stairs, and collect the royal music teacher's notes in front of the piano.

location.zh: 通过长走廊到存档点，处理主梯精英后走另一侧楼梯，主路房间中有第三块鬼石。
location.en: Cross the long corridor, rest, and defeat the stair elite. The third Soulstone is in the room along the other stair route.

location.zh: 房间宝箱内有中央大剧院钥匙，右侧隐藏房间里可取得第四块鬼石。
location.en: Take the Central Theatre Key from the chest and search the hidden room on the right for the fourth Soulstone.

location.zh: 房间宝箱内有中央大剧院钥匙，右侧隐藏房间里可取得第四块鬼石。
location.en: Take the Central Theatre Key from the chest and search the hidden room on the right for the fourth Soulstone.

location.zh: 开门进入模型区域，模型旁可拾取罗维利恩的圆盘碎片，搜完再继续。
location.en: Open the door into the model area and collect the Rovelion disc fragment beside the model before advancing.

location.zh: 模型后有唱片机，继续检查右侧雕像后的隐藏门，里面罐子中有罐子精灵。
location.en: Pass the gramophone behind the model and open the hidden door behind the right statue for a Jarling inside.

location.zh: 进入下一存档点补给，贴左侧墙探索，取得赫斯讨伐战（二）。
location.en: Rest at the next checkpoint and follow the left wall for Hismar Campaign II.

location.zh: 下楼搜角落并清理分身骑士，探索鬼气弥漫的枪刃；确认收集后进入前方首领门。
location.en: Search below and defeat the cloning knight for the ghostly spear blade route, then enter the boss doorway.

location.zh: 进帝都下电梯到存档点，先检查右侧木栏，打破后进入内部取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Ride down to the imperial city checkpoint, break the wooden barrier on the right, and take the first Soulstone inside.

location.zh: 沿左侧落到下层，进入主路左门。清完房间士兵，在右上角拾取关于莉丝（一）。
location.en: Drop to the left and enter the left doorway. Defeat the soldiers and collect About Reese I in the upper right corner.

name.en: The Day the Black Moon Rose IV

location.zh: 搜左侧房屋并放下返回存档点的梯子，再到前方石像，右边可拾取黑月升起之日（四）。
location.en: Search the left house and lower the shortcut ladder, then collect The Day the Black Moon Rose IV beside the statue on the right.

location.zh: 打破毒瘤继续，搜完宝箱后到分岔先走右边，墙内藏着第二块鬼石。
location.en: Break the growths, search the chest, and take the right branch to the second Soulstone inside the wall.

location.zh: 探索支路取得鬼气弥漫的锤子，过桥激活存档点后再继续下行。
location.en: Search the branch for the ghostly hammer, then cross the bridge to the checkpoint before descending.

location.zh: 利用掩体接近下层火球敌人，搜管道记忆后回看流水口，正下方有第三块鬼石。
location.en: Use cover against the fireball enemies, search the pipe memory, and look below the water outlet for the third Soulstone.

location.zh: 乘电梯到新存档点，进房爬梯，右侧阳台有狂龙赫斯搬运日记。
location.en: Ride to the next checkpoint, climb the ladder inside the building, and take Hismar's transport diary on the right balcony.

location.zh: 进入教堂激活存档点，再绕到大雕像背后，击碎第四块鬼石。
location.en: Activate the church checkpoint and check behind the large statue for the fourth Soulstone.

location.zh: 沿教堂外侧上楼穿过书房，左侧房屋的角落罐子中有罐子精灵。
location.en: Climb through the study outside the church and inspect the corner jar in the left house for a Jarling.

location.zh: 从房屋后面沿边缘通过，注意落脚点，搜支路取得鬼气弥漫的双剑。
location.en: Follow the narrow ledge behind the house and search the side route for the ghostly twin blades.

location.zh: 开门连通教堂后继续，岔路先向右检查两辆水车，后方平台上是第五块鬼石。
location.en: Open the church shortcut, then take the right fork to the two waterwheels for the fifth Soulstone on the platform behind them.

location.zh: 狂龙赫斯复苏后会使用混沌与激光攻击，避开正面蓄力再寻找空档。战后获得屠戮者卷轴并返回据点。
location.en: Hismar returns with chaos and laser attacks. Avoid the charged frontal attacks, defeat him, and receive the slayer scroll.

location.zh: 进入大神殿后到存档点，沿下层道路开正面大门，门后右侧有第一块鬼石。
location.en: Reach the sanctuary checkpoint and open the main gate below. The first Soulstone is just inside on the right.

location.zh: 从右侧小门继续，经过雕像后朝城堡高处看，可先用标枪尝试取得第二块鬼石，也可到上层再拿。
location.en: Continue through the right doorway and look toward the high castle ledge for the second Soulstone, reachable now or from above later.

location.zh: 清理门前魅魔后进城堡，沿楼梯上行到雕像旁，取得关于莉丝（二）。
location.en: Defeat the succubus, enter the castle, and climb to the statue for About Reese II.

location.zh: 出门向左打破箱子可补拿第二块鬼石。到下一存档点后进入旁门，击败分身精英取得维拉德斯的忏悔录。
location.en: Break the left crates outside to reach the second Soulstone if missed. Defeat the cloning elite beyond the next checkpoint for Viladus's confession.

location.zh: 让两座雕像面对面，随后搜右侧小房间。处理伏兵后打破里面罐子，取得罐子精灵。
location.en: Face the two statues toward each other, then clear the ambush in the small right room and collect its Jarling.

location.zh: 上楼搜棺材后宝箱并激活存档点，右侧隐藏门内有敌人与第三块鬼石。
location.en: Loot the chest behind the coffin and activate the checkpoint. Open the hidden door on the right for the third Soulstone.

location.zh: 沿楼梯到顶层，先清理右侧敌人，拾取其身后的神殿骑士卷轴。
location.en: Climb to the top floor and defeat the enemies on the right for the temple knight scroll behind them.

location.zh: 沿屋顶下落并开铁门捷径，拾取大地净化魔法卷轴，再向左侧房梁取关于莉丝（三）。
location.en: Drop along the roof, open the shortcut, take the earth cleansing scroll, and cross the left beam for About Reese III.

location.zh: 沿屋顶下落并开铁门捷径，拾取大地净化魔法卷轴，再向左侧房梁取关于莉丝（三）。
location.en: Drop along the roof, open the shortcut, take the earth cleansing scroll, and cross the left beam for About Reese III.

location.zh: 取记忆后不要继续往下跳，改爬梯子返回上层，前方楼梯后有第四块鬼石。
location.en: After the memory, climb back up instead of dropping farther. The fourth Soulstone is behind the stairs ahead.

location.zh: 回屋顶搜宝箱与支路，取得鬼气弥漫的兽牙护链，再回电梯。
location.en: Search the roof chest and side route for the ghostly fang necklace, then return to the elevator.

location.zh: 乘电梯上行到楼梯区域，向右侧高处投标枪，取得第五块鬼石。
location.en: Ride the elevator to the stairs and javelin the fifth Soulstone high on the right.

location.zh: 莉丝有两管生命，先以法术为主，后转近战。场内光壁也能遮挡她自己的招式；胜利后取得褪色回忆卷轴。
location.en: Reese has two health bars, shifting from spells toward melee. Her light walls can block her own attacks. Receive the faded memories scroll after victory.

location.zh: 检查雕像后道具并操作机关打开地道，下去后先走左边取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Search behind the statue and open the underground passage with the mechanism. Take the left branch for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 回右侧攀梯到旋转楼梯房，踩机关旋转楼梯后先回头进走廊，尽头有第二块鬼石。
location.en: Climb the right ladder to the rotating staircase, use the floor mechanism, and return to the corridor for the second Soulstone at its end.

location.zh: 多次旋转楼梯后到达芙罗娜处选择结局分支；先检查日记收集，再作决定。后续书房靠书柜机关开路，过道上方有第三块鬼石。
location.en: Rotate the staircase to reach Daphrona's ending choice and check journal progress first. Use the study bookshelf mechanisms and find the third Soulstone above the passage.

location.zh: 沿旋转楼梯继续到新存档点，走右侧上层廊道，倒下的柜子后有罐子精灵。
location.en: Follow the spiral stairs to the checkpoint and take the upper right corridor for the Jarling behind the fallen cabinet.

location.zh: 搜左门后回下层，从右侧上坡进房，打开隐藏墙壁，里面有第四块鬼石。
location.en: Search the left room, return below, and take the right slope to the hidden wall containing the fourth Soulstone.

location.zh: 奥兹玛至少有两个战斗阶段，部分结局分支还会追加战斗。战胜第二阶段可取得混沌之主卷轴。
location.en: Ozma has at least two phases, with an extra encounter on some ending branches. Defeating the second phase grants the lord of chaos scroll.

location.zh: 向杜伊穆克接取罐子爱好者。任务内先找桥前的第一个罐子，经过隐形敌人下到屋内取第二个，再沿屋外路线取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Accept Jar Enthusiast from Duimuk. Find the first jar before the bridge and the second inside the house below the invisible enemy, then take the first Soulstone outside.

location.zh: 第一个罐子在开场前方桥边。
location.en: The first jar is beside the bridge near the start.

location.zh: 经过隐形敌人后下到房屋，第二个罐子在屋内。
location.en: Pass the invisible enemy and descend to the house for the second jar inside.

location.zh: 爬右屋楼梯，左屋内取第三个罐子，继续前进左屋取第四个，出门右上方取第五个，路尽头左侧取第六个。离开前绕到瞭望塔后打掉第二块鬼石。
location.en: Climb the right house stairs. Find jars three and four in the left houses, five above on the right, and six at the road’s left end. Take the second Soulstone behind the tower before leaving.

location.zh: 爬右侧房屋楼梯上去，第三个罐子在左边房屋内。
location.en: Climb the stairs in the right house; the third jar is in the house on the left.

location.zh: 沿道路再走一段，第四个罐子仍在左侧房屋内。
location.en: Continue along the road for the fourth jar in the next house on the left.

location.zh: 离开第四个罐子所在房屋，检查右上方，第五个罐子在这里。
location.en: Leave the fourth jar’s house and inspect the upper right area for the fifth jar.

location.zh: 最后一个罐子在道路尽头左侧，取完后出现返回传送点。
location.en: The last jar is on the left at the end of the road, where the return portal appears.

location.zh: 向铁匠接取任务后进入蜘蛛坟墓。到分岔先搜左边鬼石，再检查右边罐子，两处都拿完再继续。
location.en: Enter the Spider Tomb for the blacksmith's quest. At the fork, collect the Soulstone on the left and the Jarling on the right.

location.zh: 向铁匠接取任务后进入蜘蛛坟墓。到分岔先搜左边鬼石，再检查右边罐子，两处都拿完再继续。
location.en: Enter the Spider Tomb for the blacksmith's quest. At the fork, collect the Soulstone on the left and the Jarling on the right.

location.zh: 进入主线时锁住的门，防范头顶蝙蝠。处理沙虫记忆后，左侧平台有第二块鬼石。
location.en: Enter the door that was locked during the main mission. After the sandworm memory, take the second Soulstone on the left platform.

location.zh: 向达芙罗娜接取悲惨之夜。进入村庄后右侧房屋有少年的日记，对面房屋内藏第一块鬼石。
location.en: Accept Tragic Night from Daphrona. Find the boy's diary in the right house and the first Soulstone in the house opposite.

location.zh: 向达芙罗娜接取悲惨之夜。进入村庄后右侧房屋有少年的日记，对面房屋内藏第一块鬼石。
location.en: Accept Tragic Night from Daphrona. Find the boy's diary in the right house and the first Soulstone in the house opposite.

location.zh: 继续深入可取火召唤卷轴。过桥后下方记忆是陷阱，先检查左侧罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Collect the fire summon scroll as you advance. Beyond the bridge, avoid the false memory and inspect the Jarling jar on the left.

location.zh: 继续深入可取火召唤卷轴。过桥后下方记忆是陷阱，先检查左侧罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Collect the fire summon scroll as you advance. Beyond the bridge, avoid the false memory and inspect the Jarling jar on the left.

location.zh: 搜右侧木屋宝箱后回头仰望，用标枪打掉上方第二块鬼石。
location.en: Loot the wooden house on the right, turn around, and use a javelin on the second Soulstone above.

location.zh: 沿左路取得堕落守护神卷轴，再挑战再次出现的鹿头首领。胜利后取得幸福的少年和鹿，完成支线。
location.en: Take the left route for the fallen guardian scroll, defeat the returning deer headed boss, and receive The Happy Boy and the Deer.

location.zh: 沿左路取得堕落守护神卷轴，再挑战再次出现的鹿头首领。胜利后取得幸福的少年和鹿，完成支线。
location.en: Take the left route for the fallen guardian scroll, defeat the returning deer headed boss, and receive The Happy Boy and the Deer.

location.zh: 与奥克萨娜交谈进入寂静神庙。沿左路搜宝箱，再上右侧楼梯，向对面鬼石投标枪；梯子下有没落君主卷轴。
location.en: Enter Silent Temple after speaking to Oksana. Search the left route, climb the right stairs for the Soulstone opposite, and collect the scroll below the ladder.

location.zh: 与奥克萨娜交谈进入寂静神庙。沿左路搜宝箱，再上右侧楼梯，向对面鬼石投标枪；梯子下有没落君主卷轴。
location.en: Enter Silent Temple after speaking to Oksana. Search the left route, climb the right stairs for the Soulstone opposite, and collect the scroll below the ladder.

location.zh: 路上拾取某个魔法学者的记录。平台宝箱有爆炸陷阱，宝箱下的罐子藏着罐子精灵；继续击败亡灵士兵，交付后开放装备服务。
location.en: Collect the magic scholar's record and the Jarling below the trapped chests. Defeat the undead soldier and report back to unlock gear services.

location.zh: 路上拾取某个魔法学者的记录。平台宝箱有爆炸陷阱，宝箱下的罐子藏着罐子精灵；继续击败亡灵士兵，交付后开放装备服务。
location.en: Collect the magic scholar's record and the Jarling below the trapped chests. Defeat the undead soldier and report back to unlock gear services.

location.zh: 追寻龙的声音后沿楼梯进入上层，朝右侧高处投掷标枪，打掉第一块鬼石。
location.en: Follow the dragon's voice and climb the stairs. Use a javelin on the first Soulstone high on the right.

location.zh: 左门内先取猎杀者卷轴，再沿凹槽逐个检查，第二个凹槽里有第二块鬼石。
location.en: Collect the hunter scroll behind the left door, then inspect the recesses for the second Soulstone in the second one.

location.zh: 左门内先取猎杀者卷轴，再沿凹槽逐个检查，第二个凹槽里有第二块鬼石。
location.en: Collect the hunter scroll behind the left door, then inspect the recesses for the second Soulstone in the second one.

location.zh: 经过宝箱与电梯到存档点，正面角落的罐子中有罐子精灵。
location.en: Pass the chest and elevator to the checkpoint, then inspect the jar in the corner ahead for a Jarling.

location.zh: 与塞伦斯交谈后过桥，攀梯走右侧，下层平台有本任务第一块鬼石。
location.en: Speak to Xilence, cross the bridge, climb the ladder, and turn right for the first Soulstone on the lower platform.

location.zh: 回主路吸收记忆。鬼石左侧房间里的宝箱会爆炸，打开后可获得混沌蚕食卷轴。
location.en: Return to the memory on the route. The trapped chest in the room left of the Soulstone contains the chaos erosion scroll.

location.zh: 打破挡路推车继续前进，搜完外侧空地后，前方左侧罐子里有罐子精灵。
location.en: Break the cart blocking the route, search the outside clearing, and find the Jarling in the jar ahead on the left.

location.zh: 到下一存档点后抬头检查左边，用标枪取得上方第二块鬼石。
location.en: At the next checkpoint, look up to the left and javelin the second Soulstone overhead.

location.zh: 进入帕维尔的遗言，留意敌人死亡后的骷髅追击。先向右侧通道深入，角落能找到第一块鬼石。
location.en: Enter Pavel's Final Words and avoid the skulls released by defeated enemies. Follow the right passage for the first Soulstone in the corner.

location.zh: 从鬼石处返回，走门左边并先清高台远程敌人。左侧第一间房屋内有罐子精灵。
location.en: Return from the Soulstone, take the left gate, and clear the ranged enemies above. The first house on the left contains a Jarling.

location.zh: 搜第二间房可取刺客秘方，之后沿右侧楼梯上行。支路尸体旁有愤怒盗贼卷轴。
location.en: Search the second room for the assassin recipe, climb the right stairs, and check the body on the side route for the angry bandit scroll.

location.zh: 搜第二间房可取刺客秘方，之后沿右侧楼梯上行。支路尸体旁有愤怒盗贼卷轴。
location.en: Search the second room for the assassin recipe, climb the right stairs, and check the body on the side route for the angry bandit scroll.

location.zh: 击败楼梯下的精英取得盗贼的指令。打开电梯开关后先回头，用标枪打掉身后高处第二块鬼石，再乘电梯。
location.en: Defeat the elite below the stairs for the bandit's orders. Call the elevator, then javelin the second Soulstone high behind you before riding down.

location.zh: 击败楼梯下的精英取得盗贼的指令。打开电梯开关后先回头，用标枪打掉身后高处第二块鬼石，再乘电梯。
location.en: Defeat the elite below the stairs for the bandit's orders. Call the elevator, then javelin the second Soulstone high behind you before riding down.

location.zh: 完成主线后向特利斯坦接取为何要抛弃我们。进图操作机关，右侧可取得战士卷轴。
location.en: Accept Why Did You Abandon Us from Tristan. Activate the opening mechanism and collect the warrior scroll on the right.

location.zh: 绕过木板时提防盾兵伏击，右侧大水缸中藏着第一块鬼石。
location.en: Watch for the shield soldier behind the boards. The first Soulstone is inside the large water jar on the right.

location.zh: 沿楼梯下行并清理精英，回到主路直走，左侧支路可取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Descend past the elite, return to the main route, and check the left branch for the second Soulstone.

name.en: The Day the Black Moon Rose I

location.zh: 进入门口时提防上方落下的敌人，右侧红色拾取物是黑月升起之日（一）。
location.en: Watch for an enemy dropping above the doorway. Collect The Day the Black Moon Rose I on the right.

location.zh: 从上层木板助跑跳到下层平台，避免直接踏空；平台上的红色道具是野兽虐杀者卷轴。
location.en: Make a running jump from the upper boards to the lower platform for the beast slayer scroll.

location.zh: 沿最低处木板进入内部，中间地板会碎，先保证生命值。左侧可拾取生命创造之旅。
location.en: Enter along the lowest boards, watching for the breakable floor. Collect Journey of Life Creation on the left.

location.zh: 搜完右侧道具再检查书架角落，罐子中有罐子精灵。
location.en: Search the right pickup, then inspect the jar in the bookshelf corner for a Jarling.

location.zh: 下楼清理群敌，打碎大水缸，取得鬼气弥漫的双剑后继续。
location.en: Clear the enemies below the stairs and smash the large jar for the ghostly twin blades.

location.zh: 到对面平台后防范激光敌人，也检查身后；敌人旁边可找到第三块鬼石。
location.en: At the opposite platform, check behind you as well as ahead for laser enemies. The third Soulstone is beside one of them.

location.zh: 向尤利安接取里侬矿山逃脱记。进入矿洞清理蜘蛛群，吸收记忆后检查角落罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Accept Escaping Linon Mine from Yulian. Clear the spiders, collect the memory, and inspect the corner jar for a Jarling.

location.zh: 过桥先处理产卵蜘蛛，打掉头顶蛛网取得鬼气弥漫的盾牌，再沿右侧道路找到第一块鬼石。
location.en: Clear the spawning spider beyond the bridge and break the web above it for the ghostly shield. Take the right path to the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 过桥先处理产卵蜘蛛，打掉头顶蛛网取得鬼气弥漫的盾牌，再沿右侧道路找到第一块鬼石。
location.en: Clear the spawning spider beyond the bridge and break the web above it for the ghostly shield. Take the right path to the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 搜蜘蛛卵间的爆炸宝箱后过桥，在存档点右侧下梯，处理沙虫记忆，再检查右边第二块鬼石。
location.en: Cross to the checkpoint after the trapped chest. Descend its right ladder, deal with the sandworm memory, and take the second Soulstone on the right.

location.zh: 进入下一洞窟先抬头处理偷袭蜘蛛，打掉头顶蛛网取得冰封雪山卷轴。
location.en: Watch for the spider overhead in the next cave. Break the web above for the frozen snowfield scroll.

location.zh: 进入最后的命令，沿路救援士兵。炸药桶房间先处理弓兵，出门后检查左侧罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Rescue soldiers during The Last Command. Deal with the archer in the barrel room, then inspect the jar on the left after leaving.

location.zh: 搜完右侧小路回主路，穿过房间另一侧出口。前方楼梯左边有本任务的鬼石。
location.en: Return from the right branch and cross the room to its other exit. The mission's Soulstone is left of the stairs ahead.

location.zh: 进入拉克里玛任务，桥上远程强敌会投火球。击败后到它身后拾取噬魂者卷轴。
location.en: Enter Lacrima, defeat the fireball enemy on the bridge, and collect the soul eater scroll behind it.

location.zh: 从左侧小门进入，检查左边木栏后的罐子精灵，再继续深入。
location.en: Enter the small left doorway and check behind the wooden railing on the left for a Jarling.

location.zh: 搜左侧宝箱后从右梯下行，探索下层支路，取得鬼气弥漫的剑柄。
location.en: Loot the left chest, descend the right stairs, and search the lower branch for the ghostly sword hilt.

location.zh: 沿柱子降到下层，清理丧尸后过桥，左侧楼梯上方有本任务鬼石。
location.en: Descend along the pillar, clear the undead, and cross the bridge for the Soulstone above the left stairs.

location.zh: 调查莉迪亚的下落，进图后沿楼梯探索，打掉空中敌人，角落木箱后是第一块鬼石。
location.en: Investigate Lydia's fate, climb the opening stairs, and check behind the corner crates for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 探索大厅右侧，处理精英并搜宝箱后站在楼梯上向左上方看，用标枪打掉第二块鬼石。
location.en: Search the hall's right side and defeat the elite, then javelin the second Soulstone high to the left from the stairs.

location.zh: 开关连通开场区域后走主梯左侧，防范激光敌人，内部柜子之间藏着罐子精灵。
location.en: Open the shortcut, take the main stairs on the left, and watch for laser enemies. The Jarling is between the cabinets inside.

location.zh: 搜左侧小房宝箱后，贴左侧脚手架上行，前方可拿到沉水魔女卷轴。
location.en: Search the left room, then climb the scaffolding along the left side for the drowned witch scroll.

location.zh: 到存档点后检查左边下行梯子，从梯子附近抬头，用标枪打第三块鬼石。
location.en: At the checkpoint, inspect the descending ladder on the left and look up for the third Soulstone.

location.zh: 进入巴鲁斯的斧头，沿楼梯下行与巴鲁斯之子对话，再搜支路里的鬼气弥漫的圣物。
location.en: Descend to speak to Varus's son, then search the side route for the ghostly relic during Varus's Axe.

location.zh: 用灯笼应对隐身敌人并操作机关，搜宝箱后继续沿门外路线，左侧可取龙鳞卷轴。
location.en: Use the lantern against invisible enemies, activate the mechanism, and take the dragon scale scroll on the left beyond the chest.

location.zh: 回到开场存档点打开右侧开关，抬头检查右边高处，取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Return to the opening checkpoint and use the right switch, then look high to the right for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 存档点旁的小门已可进入，先清右侧支路再向左搜到尽头，角落里是第二块鬼石。
location.en: Enter the newly opened door beside the checkpoint. Search the right branch, then the far left corner for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 先搜门左侧宝箱，再向右侧房间走，里面有记忆和罐子精灵。
location.en: Loot the chest left of the doorway, then enter the right room for the memory and Jarling.

location.zh: 与贝雷里安接取精准之亚特兰特。留意桶中炸药，沿路探索冥界气息所在支路后继续救援。
location.en: Accept Atlante the Precise from Bellerian, watch for explosive jars, and search the side route for Netherworld Energy.

location.zh: 沿左路进入，右边石后可取逃亡魔法师卷轴；再向左检查角落，取得本任务鬼石。
location.en: Follow the left path, search behind the rock on the right for the fugitive mage scroll, and take the Soulstone in the left corner.

location.zh: 沿左路进入，右边石后可取逃亡魔法师卷轴；再向左检查角落，取得本任务鬼石。
location.en: Follow the left path, search behind the rock on the right for the fugitive mage scroll, and take the Soulstone in the left corner.

location.zh: 清理盾兵与弓兵后下行到存档点，左边拾取死灵术研究日记（一）。
location.en: Defeat the shield soldier and archer, descend to the checkpoint, and collect the first necromancy diary on the left.

location.zh: 从存档点向前处理骷髅，打破左侧罐子，取得罐子精灵。
location.en: Clear the skeleton beyond the checkpoint and break the jar on the left for a Jarling.

location.zh: 处理路口远程骷髅后上后方楼梯，左边角落有第二份死灵术研究日记。
location.en: Clear the ranged skeletons at the junction and climb the rear stairs for the second necromancy diary in the left corner.

location.zh: 接取猩红踪迹后进入任务，先搜右侧台阶，再走左侧走廊到底，取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Enter Crimson Trace, search the right steps, and follow the left corridor to its end for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 处理会分身的精英，搜左侧台阶后回主路，路左边可取得预言（二）。
location.en: Defeat the cloning elite and search the left steps, then collect Prophecy II along the left side of the main path.

location.zh: 继续通过记忆与敌人区域，抬头用标枪击碎左侧高处第二块鬼石。
location.en: Continue past the memory and enemies, then javelin the second Soulstone high on the left.

location.zh: 从左侧楼梯进入房间，吸收地上记忆后检查旁边罐子，里面有罐子精灵。
location.en: Climb the left stairs, collect the room's memory, and inspect the jar beside it for a Jarling.

location.zh: 在存档点补给后完成首领战，继续下行从书柜后密道搜宝箱，取得歌唱之鹰的头发再离开。
location.en: Defeat the boss after resting, then descend through the bookshelf passage for the chest containing the singing eagle's hair.

location.zh: 进入最后的护卫军与特利斯坦交谈，接近主路右侧拾取物时抬头，对面高台是第一块鬼石。
location.en: Speak to Tristan during The Last Guard. Look across from the right side of the main route for the first Soulstone on the high platform.

location.zh: 清理门后的怪物进入大厅，右侧可取得父亲的遗书。
location.en: Clear the enemies beyond the doorway and collect the father's final letter on the hall's right side.

location.zh: 吸收大厅正面尸体上的记忆，再到后方检查第二块鬼石。
location.en: Collect the memory from the body ahead in the hall, then inspect the rear area for the second Soulstone.

location.zh: 沿大厅左侧到阳台，再下楼清精英后绕回上层。后续房间右边有染血的护卫军记录。
location.en: Take the left hall route through the balcony and lower elite, then return upstairs for the bloodstained guard record on the right.

location.zh: 先不走返回大厅的铁门，回头上旋转楼梯，右边罐子内有罐子精灵。
location.en: Leave the hall shortcut for later and climb the spiral stairs. The Jarling is in the jar on the right.

location.zh: 沿走廊左侧搜记忆，再从落脚点下到血池，中间拾取嗜血狂徒卷轴。
location.en: Search the left corridor memory, then drop to the blood pool for the bloodthirsty fanatic scroll in its center.

location.zh: 进入超越者之剑，经过存档点下楼，打破右侧隐藏墙壁，取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Enter Transcendental Sword, descend past the checkpoint, and break the hidden wall on the right for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 下到楼层吸收记忆，先操作桥梁与地板机关，搜支路取得鬼气弥漫的双剑。
location.en: Descend to the memory, operate the bridge and floor mechanisms, and search the branch for the ghostly twin blades.

name.en: The Day the Black Moon Rose III

location.zh: 完成地板机关并用标枪放下木桥，回上层从右高台下落到存档点。开左门击败分身精英，打破右边棺材处隐藏墙壁，取得黑月升起之日（三）。
location.en: Lower the bridge, circle above, and drop to the checkpoint. Defeat the clone elite behind the left door and open the hidden wall by the right coffin for The Day the Black Moon Rose III.

location.zh: 清理楼下骷髅，前方右侧宝箱会爆炸，打开后取得梦殇之影卷轴。
location.en: Clear the skeletons below. The trapped chest on the right contains the shadow of nightmares scroll.

location.zh: 前方铁门仍锁着，改走左边。木板后有地板陷阱，旁边罐子中藏着罐子精灵。
location.en: Take the left route around the locked gate. Avoid the floor trap behind the boards and inspect the adjacent jar for a Jarling.

location.zh: 从右门进入并吸收角落记忆，沿楼梯上行，左侧可取赫斯讨伐战（一）。
location.en: Enter the right doorway, collect the memory, and climb the stairs for Hismar Campaign I on the left.

location.zh: 继续走左侧楼梯，抬头找高处铁笼，用标枪打掉笼中第二块鬼石。
location.en: Climb the left stairs and use a javelin on the second Soulstone inside the cage high above.

location.zh: 处理平台敌人后先不进闸门，从左梯下行搜宝箱与鬼气弥漫的剑柄，再回主路。
location.en: Defeat the platform enemy, search below the left stairs for the chest and ghostly sword hilt, then return to the gate.

location.zh: 通过铁门后下行到存档点，击败楼梯下精英可取得圣职者的记录。
location.en: Pass the gate and descend to the checkpoint. Defeat the elite below the stairs for the priest's record.

location.zh: 接取百人敢死队进入任务，过桥前检查右侧，本任务鬼石就在桥边。
location.en: Enter the suicide squad mission and inspect the bridge's right side for its Soulstone.

location.zh: 沿楼梯左侧清理士兵，打开壁画隐藏门。右侧罐子内有罐子精灵，密道里可取预言（三）。
location.en: Clear the soldiers left of the stairs and open the mural passage. Find the Jarling on the right and Prophecy III inside.

location.zh: 沿楼梯左侧清理士兵，打开壁画隐藏门。右侧罐子内有罐子精灵，密道里可取预言（三）。
location.en: Clear the soldiers left of the stairs and open the mural passage. Find the Jarling on the right and Prophecy III inside.

location.zh: 出密道左转进入隔壁门，下楼后再开走廊左侧壁画，里面左侧拾取预言（四）。
location.en: Leave the passage and take the next door on the left. Open the lower corridor mural for Prophecy IV on the left inside.

location.zh: 搜完宝箱回走廊到存档点，首领门口先拾取敢死队的决意。
location.en: Return from the chest to the checkpoint and collect the suicide squad's resolve outside the boss entrance.

name.zh: 第九十九只猫头鹰的遗书

location.zh: 清理门后被侵蚀的士兵与怪物，胜利后取得第九十九只猫头鹰的遗书，再传送离开。
location.en: Clear the corrupted soldiers and monsters, receive the Ninety Ninth Owl's last letter, and leave through the portal.

location.zh: 进入残余的混沌先回头取记忆，从左侧进入角落取得鬼石，再走传送门主路。
location.en: At the start of Residual Chaos, turn back for the memory and take the left corner for the Soulstone before using the portal.

location.zh: 连续传送后先搜左侧宝箱，再沿旁边主路前进，途中取得埃拉梅因的笔记。
location.en: Search the chest after the portals, then follow the main route for Elamein's notes.

location.zh: 走到尽头操作开关，再次传送后正前方可取得坦尼娅的实验记录（三）。
location.en: Use the switch at the route's end and teleport again to Tanya's third experiment record directly ahead.

location.zh: 主路上楼后打开左侧隐藏门，取无尽悲剧卷轴，并检查角落罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Open the hidden door left of the stairs for the endless tragedy scroll and the Jarling in the corner.

location.zh: 主路上楼后打开左侧隐藏门，取无尽悲剧卷轴，并检查角落罐子中的罐子精灵。
location.en: Open the hidden door left of the stairs for the endless tragedy scroll and the Jarling in the corner.

location.zh: 接取抗命帮助尤利安寻找家人。先搜左侧宝箱，再走右梯，上方正面拾取艾芙琳的手记。
location.en: Help Yulian search for his family during Disobedience. Loot the left chest, climb the right stairs, and collect Evelyn's notes ahead.

location.zh: 过存档点绕开锁门，从右侧落到街道。击败魅魔后检查街边红色道具，取得鬼气弥漫的盾牌。
location.en: Pass the checkpoint, circle the locked gate, and drop to the street on the right. Defeat the succubus and collect the red ghostly shield pickup nearby.

location.zh: 从魅魔所在楼梯上行，站在楼梯处用标枪打掉左侧高处鬼石，再打开铁门。
location.en: Climb the stairs used by the succubus and javelin the Soulstone high on the left before opening the gate.

location.zh: 继续向前到右侧尸体堆吸收记忆，旁边草堆内的罐子藏着罐子精灵。
location.en: Collect the memory by the bodies on the right and inspect the jar in the nearby grass for a Jarling.

location.zh: 进左门完成任务战斗，胜利后取得尤利安妻子的信，再返回交付。
location.en: Enter the left doorway, finish the fight, and receive the letter from Yulian's wife before reporting back.

location.zh: 下行到存档点后搜左侧木桶箱，取得罐子精灵。右侧房间是连续首领挑战，完成三场战斗与达芙罗娜对话即可结束任务。
location.en: Find the Jarling in the barrels left of the checkpoint, then enter the right room for three consecutive boss fights and Daphrona's dialogue.

location.zh: 与入口 NPC 对话后沿主路搜宝箱，向左几步检查成组罐子，其中有罐子精灵。
location.en: Speak to the starting NPCs, loot the chest, then inspect the group of jars a few steps left for a Jarling.

location.zh: 下楼沿路通过毒瘤区域，向右侧草地搜寻，本任务第一块鬼石在这里。
location.en: Descend through the growths and check the grass on the right for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 利用附近毒瘤处理精英，到存档点后上楼。雕像旁取鬼气弥漫的宝石，柱子背后是第二块鬼石。
location.en: Use the nearby growths against the elite, then climb beyond the checkpoint for the ghostly gem beside the statue and the second Soulstone behind the pillar.

location.zh: 利用附近毒瘤处理精英，到存档点后上楼。雕像旁取鬼气弥漫的宝石，柱子背后是第二块鬼石。
location.en: Use the nearby growths against the elite, then climb beyond the checkpoint for the ghostly gem beside the statue and the second Soulstone behind the pillar.

location.zh: 开门清房后进入首领区，优先处理远程敌人。战后取得小丑的短剑，完成任务。
location.en: Clear the room and defeat the final group, prioritizing ranged enemies. Receive the jester's dagger to finish the quest.

location.zh: 集齐三块圆盘碎片后开放誓约。进图开铁门，探索首段支路并取得鬼气弥漫的枪刃。
location.en: Collect all three disc fragments to unlock The Vow. Open the first gate and search the opening branch for the ghostly spear blade.

location.zh: 经过精英后出铁门，右侧看似死路的墙是隐藏门，打开后取得第一块鬼石。
location.en: Pass the elite and leave through the gate. Open the hidden wall at the right dead end for the first Soulstone.

location.zh: 回分岔先走左边小房间，楼梯附近墙壁也是隐藏门，搜到鬼气弥漫的圣物后折回。
location.en: Take the left room at the fork and open the hidden wall by the stairs for the ghostly relic before returning.

location.zh: 改走右路搜雕像与角落道具，左侧罐子内有罐子精灵。
location.en: Take the right route, search the statue room, and inspect the jar on the left for a Jarling.

location.zh: 不要再下回已探索区域，改走另一条走廊。清理大型骷髅后，身后金色拾取物是冥界气息。
location.en: Take the other corridor instead of returning below. Defeat the large skeletons and collect Netherworld Energy behind them.

location.zh: 跳到下层吸收记忆并开铁门，乘电梯前先回头，拾取赫斯讨伐战（三）。
location.en: Drop to the memory and open the gate. Before riding the elevator, turn back for Hismar Campaign III.

location.zh: 电梯后在新存档点补给，岔路先向左探索，小瀑布下有赫斯讨伐战（四）。
location.en: Rest beyond the elevator and search the left branch for Hismar Campaign IV below the small waterfall.

location.zh: 搜完尽头宝箱回主路，清理守门怪，右侧柱后可取得第二块鬼石。
location.en: Return from the side chest, defeat the gatekeeper, and take the second Soulstone behind the right pillar.

name.en: The Day the Black Moon Rose II

location.zh: 补充收集：黑月升起之日（二）。若尚未取得，可从第四区实验楼魔剑处回身，经栏杆缺口下到房间，左转进入通道，上台阶后穿过右侧房间，再沿梯子下到实验大厅。沿大型实验容器房的右墙检查，在右侧书桌旁拾取这份文书；完成后返回当前任务路线继续前进。
location.en: Supplemental pickup: The Day the Black Moon Rose II. If it is missing, turn back from the Sector No. 4 laboratory Nexus and drop through the railing gap into the room. Turn left into the passage, go up the steps and through the room on the right, then descend the ladder into the laboratory hall. Follow the right wall of the large specimen-container room and collect the record beside the desk. Return to the current mission route afterward.
